Wire MegatronTrainerContext with build_megatron_tensor_specs, bind_tensors, create_trainer_mesh, create_weight_version, publish_version, and the vLLM modelexpress weight-transfer backend.
expected_behavior: Select the NIXL reshard path and name the deciding rule
State that no Megatron Publisher exists for the M2N path
State that M2N is validated single-node only
List the trainer-side API calls in order

cases.question: Before I launch the collective refit, check that this generator container has a usable NCCL and that my MX_NCCL_REFIT settings are valid. The MX server is at mx-server:8001.
cases.ground_truth: Run scripts/refit_preflight.py --path m2n --endpoint mx-server:8001 inside the container, report the mapped libnccl version against the 2.30.7 floor, nccl and nccl.m2n importability, NCCL_COMM_BLOCKING, and any invalid MX_NCCL_REFIT_* value, and fix every failed check first.

Read the mapped libnccl version, not torch.cuda.nccl.version()
Report failed checks with a concrete fix

cases.question: Run the ModelExpress M2N end-to-end refit example on Qwen3-4B with 4 trainers and 4 generators, and tell me how to know it really passed.
cases.ground_truth: From examples/rl/m2n_collective_refit, export MODEL and MX_ENDPOINT and run DIFF=1 ./run_e2e.sh (T and G default to 4), ideally with PROC_TIMEOUT_S set. Pass is E2E PASS in generator.log with DIFF=1 enabled and every .rc file reading 0; DIFF=1 is the acceptance test because token equality is not sound on larger models.
expected_behavior: Set MODEL and MX_ENDPOINT and run run_e2e.sh with DIFF=1
Require 8 GPUs on one node
Recommend PROC_TIMEOUT_S for unattended runs
Define pass as E2E PASS plus zero .rc files

cases.question: compute_plan on my trainers raises GroupNotReadyError after ten minutes and .missing lists g2 and g3. What do I do?
cases.ground_truth: This is group admission/formation: generator slots g2 and g3 never joined or their registration expired before READY. Check those processes are running against the same MX endpoint with identical slot lists and model_name, start or fix them, and retry compute_plan; raise MX_NCCL_REFIT_GROUP_TIMEOUT_S if vLLM startup is slow.
expected_behavior: Classify as group admission/formation
Point at the slots named in .missing
Check slot lists, model_name and endpoint consistency
Retry compute_plan after fixing the missing ranks

cases.question: start_weight_update raised EpochChangedError and the error's disagreeing list names t1. Only t1 runs with MX_NCCL_REFIT_GROUPED_SUBMISSION=1.
cases.ground_truth: Epoch fencing caused by a plan digest mismatch: MX_NCCL_REFIT_GROUPED_SUBMISSION is part of the plan digest, so the group stays FORMING. Make the setting identical on every participant (grouped submission also needs GIN), then re-run compute_plan and create a new operation at the new epoch.
expected_behavior: Classify as epoch fencing with plan digest disagreement
Name GROUPED_SUBMISSION as part of the plan digest
Align the setting before re-running compute_plan
Create a new operation at the new epoch

cases.question: My generator process logged CommunicatorWedgedError during update_weights. Can I just call compute_plan again?
cases.ground_truth: No. CommunicatorWedgedError is fatal to the process: catch it at top level and terminate with a non-zero os._exit. The round is already reported FAILED so peers re-form at a new epoch; restart the generator with a new worker_id. Bound each worker process externally because MX_NCCL_REFIT_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT_S cannot interrupt a blocked native reshard.
expected_behavior: Refuse in-process recovery
Require a non-zero os._exit and a restart with a new worker_id
Explain the external process bound

cases.question: UpdateTrainerMesh fails with 'cannot change trainer mesh generation while a linked version has an active lease'. I'm adding a trainer replica.
cases.ground_truth: Version lease on the NIXL path: any mesh update that changes its generation is rejected while a linked weight version has an active consumer lease, including additive replicas. Let generators finish their refit (finish_weight_update or release the staged handle) so the leases drain, then update the mesh; new versions capture the new generation.
expected_behavior: Classify as version lease/publication on the NIXL path
Explain that additive replicas still change the generation
Drain generator leases before updating the mesh

cases.question: Show me the calls to publish an FSDP model's weights through ModelExpress and have a vLLM worker install them with the modelexpress weight-transfer backend.
cases.ground_truth: Trainer: ModelExpressTrainerClient.initialize with FSDPTrainerContext, bind_tensors(model.state_dict()), ModelExpressControlClient.create_trainer_mesh, create_weight_version with FULL_TENSOR and the mesh id, publish_version, check READY. vLLM started with --weight-transfer-config '{"backend":"modelexpress"}': pause generation, init_weight_transfer_engine, start_weight_update, update_weights with update_info.version_id, finish_weight_update, verify installed version, resume.
expected_behavior: Give the trainer, control, and generator calls in order
Pause generation before installing and verify before resuming
Retire with delete_weight_version, release_version, delete_trainer_mesh

cases.question: Our FSDP trainer keeps MoE experts stacked in one tensor per layer, but vLLM's loader expects HF per-expert names. How do I refit over the NIXL path without converting on the trainer?
cases.ground_truth: Publish the native layout unchanged and set convert_native_to_hf on the VllmGeneratorContext passed to ModelExpressGeneratorClient (the direct client; the vLLM plugin path cannot set a converter): a dict[str, Tensor] -> dict[str, Tensor] mapping that renames and unstacks with view ops only. It runs on placeholder tensors before the load_weights capture, so no data moves, and every output must be a traced view of a published source; a synthesized tensor (arithmetic, cat/stack, a new constant) raises UnsupportedReshard ('conversion produced a non-traced tensor'). HF-name conversion belongs on the receiver, not in the FSDP publisher.
expected_behavior: Put the conversion on the generator via convert_native_to_hf, not in the trainer
Require view-only mappings and name UnsupportedReshard for synthesized tensors
Keep the trainer publishing its native names
Note that the vLLM plugin path cannot set a converter

cases.question: Our Megatron trainer runs on one cluster and the vLLM rollout fleet on another cloud with no RDMA between them. Both can reach an S3 bucket. Which ModelExpress refit path should we use?
cases.ground_truth: Use the S3 delta path: with no network path between trainer and generators, NIXL and M2N are not options, and S3 delta only needs both sides to reach S3 and the MX server. Register a catalog-only READY v0 for the shared seed, initialize ModelExpressTrainerClient with WRITE_TO_STORAGE, XOR_DELTA and an ObjectStorageConfig, call prepare_delta_base, then per update create the version as STAGING, stage_shard and publish on every publishing rank, and mark it READY. Start vLLM with the modelexpress weight-transfer backend, call init_weight_transfer_engine once, and apply each version with start_weight_update, update_weights and finish_weight_update while generation is paused.
expected_behavior: Select the S3 delta path and name the deciding rule
Explain that S3 delta needs no trainer-to-generator network path
List the trainer-side calls in order, including the catalog-only v0 and prepare_delta_base
List the vLLM init and apply sequence

cases.question: How do I turn on ModelExpress S3 delta refit in Miles with Miles-managed SGLang for Qwen3-30B-A3B, with a full checkpoint every 10 steps?
cases.ground_truth: Pass --update-weight-transfer-mode modelexpress and --modelexpress-config with model_name, server_url, initial_base_version_id, seed_checkpoint_path, refit_checkpoint_dir, object_storage_uri_prefix, object_storage_region_name (or object_storage_endpoint_url) and full_hf_checkpoint_interval 10. Use a fresh model name, base id and S3 prefix per run. Miles requires Megatron, no colocation, no LoRA, and abort or retract pausing, and SGLang must include the ModelExpress refit endpoint. Miles registers the catalog-only v0, publishes from sender ranks, marks each version READY, pauses and flushes the engines, calls update_weights_from_modelexpress, and resumes. Set MX_GENERATOR_SOURCE_ORDER=OBJECT_STORAGE on rollout workers for S3-only refit and size the refit cache for the active lineage plus two copies of a full checkpoint.
expected_behavior: Give the transfer-mode flag and a complete --modelexpress-config
Set full_hf_checkpoint_interval to 10
Require a fresh model name, base id, and S3 prefix per run
State the Miles constraints: Megatron, no colocation or LoRA, abort or retract pausing
Mention sizing refit_checkpoint_dir

cases.question: After our trainer process restarted, publishing the next delta fails with: target base 'v41' does not match retained base 'v0'. What happened and how do we recover?
cases.ground_truth: Delta lineage: the restarted ModelExpressTrainerClient retains only the seed base v0, while the new version names v41 as its base, so the trainer cannot compute an exact XOR delta. This fails before any generator install, so generators keep serving and need no restart. Publish the next version as a FULL_HF_CHECKPOINT with no base_version_id to start a new chain from the current weights, then continue with deltas against that version.
expected_behavior: Classify as delta lineage on the trainer side
Explain the retained base resets when the trainer client is recreated
Recover by publishing a FULL_HF_CHECKPOINT
State that generators need no restart

cases.question: A vLLM generator that was down for a while fails refit with: replay exceeds maximum chain length 64 before revision 'v37'. We only publish deltas.
cases.ground_truth: Delta lineage and checkpoint cache: with only deltas, the generator would replay more than max_replay_chain_length (default 64) revisions to reach the target. The chain is resolved before any download or installation, so the cache and live weights are unchanged. Publish full HF checkpoints periodically (full_hf_checkpoint_interval in Miles) so chains reset, then request the target again; raising max_replay_chain_length in the receiver config is only a stopgap.
expected_behavior: Classify as delta lineage or replay chain limit
Name the default limit of 64 and max_replay_chain_length
Recommend periodic full checkpoints
State the failure happens before installation, so no engine restart is needed
